title: 把旅行照片变成水彩明信片
summary: 一张照片，两种表现：上半幅保留实景，下半幅变成水彩。
use: 适合旅行手账、活动纪念卡和个人配图。
steps: 准备一张构图清楚的旅行照片，上传到支持参考图的生图工具。
复制提示词，修改画风、纸张和落款，再与参考照片一起提交。
对照照片检查上下两部分的人物、建筑和透视是否一致。
exercise: 把“水彩画”换成另一种画风时，保留构图和人物位置约束，比较风格变化。
lesson: 用同一场景连接两种画风；不仅描述好看，还写清哪些元素必须保持一致。
creator: @Taaruk_
promptOriginal: Create a refined editorial travel-art composition based on a reference photograph. The image is divided vertically into two parts: the upper section is a realistic cinematic travel photograph, while the lower section transforms the exact same scene into a delicate hand-painted watercolor illustration. Upper section: authentic candid travel photography, natural daylight, soft shadows, subtle film grain, realistic textures, sophisticated European atmosphere, documentary-style composition, people naturally walking through the scene, beautiful architectural details, slightly muted elegant colors, high-end travel magazine photography. Lower section: a {argument name="art style" default="minimalist handmade watercolor painting"} of the exact same scene, preserving the recognizable composition, architecture, people, poses, perspective and major visual elements from the photograph. Loose translucent watercolor washes, delicate ink details, visible paper texture, soft edges, imperfect brushwork, subtle pigment bleeding, airy negative space, understated pastel tones, artistic but realistic. Leave generous warm {argument name="background texture" default="ivory/off-white textured paper"} space surrounding the watercolor illustration. Add a small elegant handwritten caption near the bottom, such as {argument name="caption" default="“summer days”"} or “a quiet afternoon”, with a thin minimalist horizontal line underneath. Overall aesthetic: luxury travel journal, fine-art watercolor postcard, contemporary editorial design, nostalgic European summer, understated elegance, tactile handmade paper, sophisticated and serene. Portrait orientation, clean composition, premium art direction, no clutter, no borders, natural proportions, highly detailed photograph transitioning into an airy watercolor illustration.
promptZh: 根据一张参考照片创作精致的编辑式旅行艺术构图。画面在垂直方向分为两部分：上半部分是写实的 电影感旅行摄影，下半部分则将完全相同的场景转化为细腻的手绘水彩插画。上半部分：真实自然的旅行抓拍摄影、自然日光、柔和阴影、细腻的 胶片颗粒、写实质感、精致的欧洲氛围、纪实构图、自然走过场景的人群、美丽的建筑细节、略显低调而优雅的色彩，以及高端旅行杂志摄影风格。下半部分：以 【极简手工水彩画】 呈现完全相同的场景，保留照片中可辨识的构图、建筑、人物、姿势、透视关系和主要视觉元素。松散通透的水彩晕染、细腻的墨线细节、清晰可见的纸张纹理、柔和边缘、不完美的笔触、微妙的颜料渗色、轻盈的留白、克制的粉彩色调，兼具艺术感与写实感。在水彩插画周围留出充足的暖色 【象牙色/米白色纹理纸张】 空间。在底部附近添加一行小巧优雅的手写说明文字，例如 【“夏日时光”】 或“一个宁静的午后”，下方配一条纤细简约的水平线。整体美学：奢华旅行手账、艺术水彩明信片、当代编辑设计、怀旧的欧洲夏日、低调的优雅、可触可感的手工纸张、精致而宁静。竖向画面、简洁构图、高级艺术指导、无杂乱元素、无边框、自然比例，从细节丰富的照片自然过渡为轻盈通透的水彩插画。
translationNote: Goodcase 中文译文，本站整理术语
preparation: 准备一张自己拍摄或有权使用的旅行照片，以及支持上传参考图的生图工具。

title: 制作角色的 16 格动作图
summary: 把一个连续动作拆成 4 × 4 格，学习控制角色大小和位置。
use: 适合游戏动作素材、角色动作研究。
steps: 准备一张完整角色参考图，上传到支持参考图的生图工具。
将提示词中的动作改成挥手、走路或跳跃，生成一张 16 格图片。
依次检查每格的角色大小、脚底位置和动作衔接。生成的是图片，做成动画还需切图和播放。
exercise: 先用幅度小的挥手动作试一次，再尝试跳跃；观察角色是否被裁切。
lesson: 把连续性拆成可检查的条件：相同格子、相同比例、同一条脚底基线。
creator: @SSSS_CRYPTOMAN
promptOriginal:
このキャラクターを参照して、ゲーム用の2Dアニメーションスプライトシートを作成して。
内容は「{argument name="アクション" default="アクションを記入"}」

1つの連続したアクションを、4列×4行の合計16フレームで表現する。

【スプライトシート仕様】 ・正方形キャンバス ・4列×4行、合計16フレーム ・16個のセルは完全に同じ大きさ ・各セルの上下左右に最低10pxの余白を確保する ・枠線、グリッド線、数字、文字、記号、UIは一切不要 ・背景は全フレームで統一された単色の白 ・各フレームは左上から右へ、上段から下段へ、時間順に並べる

【最重要：サイズと位置の固定】 ・16フレームすべてでキャラクターの表示倍率を統一する ・カメラのズームイン、ズームアウトは禁止 ・足元の接地面の基準線を同じ高さに固定する ・キャラクターの中心位置がフレームの前後で大きく移動しない・動きに必要な範囲だけポーズを変える

【最重要：セル内に完全に収める】 ・髪、服、手足、武器、小物、エフェクト、残光、粒子を含むすべてを各セルの内部だけに収める ・隣のセルにはみ出さない ・余白10pxの安全領域を侵さない ・アクションが大きくなっても、キャラクターを縮小して調整しない ・必要ならエフェクトや腕の振り幅を控えめにして、セル内に収める

【描画方針】 ・2Dゲーム用スプライトとして読みやすい、明快なシルエット ・フレーム間で自然につながる動き ・1枚絵ではなく、アニメーション素材として破綻のない連続性を重視 ・各フレームの描き込み密度、線、塗り、陰影を統一する
promptZh:
请参考这个角色，为游戏制作一张 2D 动画动作分格图。
动作内容：【填写动作】。
用 4 列 × 4 行、共 16 帧表现一个连续动作。

图片规格：正方形画布，16 个格子尺寸完全相同；每格上下左右至少留 10 像素空白。不需要边框、网格线、数字、文字、符号或界面元素。所有格子统一使用纯白背景。各帧按从左到右、从上到下的时间顺序排列。

固定大小和位置：16 帧中角色显示比例相同，禁止镜头放大或缩小。脚底接地基线保持同一高度，角色中心位置不要前后大幅移动，只改变动作所需的姿势。

完整放在格子内：头发、衣服、四肢、武器、配件、特效、拖影和粒子全部留在各自格子内部，不伸入相邻格子，不占用 10 像素安全边距。动作较大时不要缩小角色，必要时减小特效或手臂摆幅。

绘制要求：轮廓清楚，适合作为 2D 游戏角色动画素材；动作在各帧之间自然衔接。重点是动画素材的连续性，不是单张插画。各帧的细节密度、线条、上色和阴影保持统一。
mediaNote: 来源截图：包含角色动作图和作者对动画切分的说明，截图内日文保留原样。
preparation: 准备一张完整、清晰的角色参考图，以及支持参考图的生图工具。

title: 真人与手绘涂鸦的饮料广告
summary: 跟着人物动作出现的闪电、星星和水果，让产品短片更有节奏。
use: 适合学习产品广告分镜和真人、动画混合表现。
steps: 先读两段分镜，准备人物和产品参考素材。将品牌、包装及人物描述改为自己的内容。
原文是两段各 15 秒的提示词。按工具支持的时长分段提交，后一段沿用前一段的人物与服装参考。
检查产品包装、人物身份及两段衔接，最后在剪辑工具里合并。画质描述是目标，不代表实际输出分辨率。
exercise: 先只做开罐的前 4 秒，检查产品文字和涂鸦互动，再扩展后续动作。
lesson: 用时间段安排动作，再把每种动作对应到一种涂鸦效果，减少无目的的镜头变化。
creator: @Caden_Flux
promptOriginal: MOUNTAIN DEW SPARK — “TOO MUCH SPARK” Duration: 15 seconds Aspect Ratio: 16:9 Style: Premium live-action commercial + playful 2D hand-drawn doodle animation, funky, energetic, youthful, colorful, fast-paced. Visual Quality: Ultra-realistic cinematic 4K, crisp product photography, natural skin texture, vibrant commercial lighting, smooth motion, dynamic camera work. CHARACTER: A cool young male in his early 20s, confident and playful, short dark slightly messy hair, expressive face, trendy oversized graphic T-shirt, relaxed baggy cargo pants and clean sneakers. Maintain STRICT face, hairstyle, clothing and identity consistency throughout. 0–4s — THE SPARK Open with a stylish low-angle tracking shot of the boy casually walking through a colorful modern city street while holding a chilled Mountain Dew Spark can. Tiny cute hand-drawn doodles subtly appear around him: stars, lightning bolts, hearts and lemons. He stops. Cut to a macro close-up of the cold can covered in condensation. He cracks it open. PSHHHH! A tiny hand-drawn lightning bolt appears above the can and vibrates with the sound. 4–8s — TOO MUCH SPARK He takes a big sip. Instantly, colorful 2D doodles explode from behind him. Lightning bolts race across the screen, cute lemons bounce past camera, stars pop around his head and cartoon speed lines surround his body. He looks surprised, then grins. Use a quick punch-in camera movement. 8–15s — THE BOOST Suddenly, he launches forward at ridiculous speed. Use rapid whip pans, low-angle tracking shots, dynamic handheld movement and energetic speed ramps as he runs through the city. Every movement triggers a doodle: Footstep → star burst Arm swing → lightning bolt Jump → comic explosion Turn → curved hand-drawn speed lines Smile → tiny floating hearts The doodles physically interact with the live-action environment, wrapping around poles, bouncing off walls and following his movement. At 15 seconds, he races toward a city staircase, preparing to jump onto it. End with a fast forward-moving camera transition that naturally continues into Part 2. CAMERA & EDITING: Fast commercial editing with smooth continuous motion. Use whip pans, crash zooms, low-angle tracking, speed ramps and match cuts. Keep movement flowing naturally so the video feels like one continuous sequence, not separate clips. DOODLE ANIMATION: Cute hand-drawn 2D doodles with imperfect sketch lines, playful expressions and bouncy animation. Playful and cute, never childish. Doodles must interact naturally with the live-action environment. PART 2: MOUNTAIN DEW SPARK — “TOO MUCH SPARK” Duration: 15 seconds Aspect Ratio: 16:9 Style: Premium live-action commercial + playful 2D hand-drawn doodle animation, funky, energetic, youthful, colorful, fast-paced. Visual Quality: Ultra-realistic cinematic 4K, crisp product photography, natural skin texture, vibrant commercial lighting, smooth motion, dynamic camera work. CHARACTER: Continue with EXACTLY the same young male from Part 1. Same face, hairstyle, oversized graphic T-shirt, baggy cargo pants, sneakers and overall identity. STRICT IDENTITY AND OUTFIT LOCK. 0–6s — DOODLE CHAOS Continue directly from Part 1 as the boy jumps onto a city staircase and races upward. Hundreds of cute hand-drawn doodles chase after him. Animated lemons bounce down the stairs. Lightning bolts zigzag beside him. Tiny stars spin through the air. Cartoon flames briefly appear behind his sneakers. Rapidly alternate between: Low-angle running shot Side tracking shot Close-up of sneakers Close-up of his excited expression Overhead shot as doodles spiral around him Use energetic whip transitions synchronized with the music. 6–11s — PRODUCT HERO The boy suddenly stops. Everything freezes. The doodles freeze mid-air around him. He casually spins the Mountain Dew Spark can toward the camera. Transition into a premium macro product close-up: cold condensation, sharp label detail, vibrant commercial lighting and fizzy energy. Hand-drawn lemons and lightning bolts begin orbiting around the can. The camera slowly pushes toward the product while the background remains softly blurred. 11–15s — FINAL EXPLOSION He takes one final sip and smirks directly at camera. On the beat, every doodle in the scene rushes toward him: ⭐ ⚡ 🍋 ❤️ 💥 They explode outward into a giant colorful hand-drawn burst behind him. He stands confidently in the center, holding the Mountain Dew Spark can toward camera. End on a clean premium hero shot of the Mountain Dew Spark can surrounded by playful doodle lightning, stars and fruit. Final feeling: refreshing, energetic, mischievous, funky and irresistibly fun. CAMERA & EDITING: Fast commercial editing with smooth continuous motion. Use whip pans, speed ramps, macro product photography, orbiting camera movement, crash zooms and match cuts. Transitions should be motivated by the character's movement and preserve visual continuity from Part 1. DOODLE ANIMATION: Cute hand-drawn 2D doodles with intermediate sketch lines, playful expressions and bouncy animation. Doodles should physically interact with the live-action world rather than appearing as static overlays. Keep them playful and stylish, never childish. NEGATIVE PROMPT: No character identity changes, no outfit changes, no inconsistent face, no extra fingers, no distorted hands, no warped product, no incorrect can shape, no unreadable logo, no duplicate cans, no floating character, no stiff movement, no random scene changes, no disconnected clips, no excessive motion blur, no dull lighting, no childish cartoon environment, no photorealistic doodles, no messy compositing, no deformed facial features, no text artifacts.
promptZh:
MOUNTAIN DEW SPARK 饮料广告：“火花太多了”
第一段：15 秒，16:9 横屏。
风格：高质感真人广告混合活泼的二维手绘涂鸦，节奏鲜明、年轻、多彩、快速。
画质目标：写实电影感 4K、清晰的产品摄影、自然皮肤纹理、鲜明的广告灯光、流畅动作和动态镜头。
人物：一位二十岁出头、自信俏皮的年轻男性，短而略乱的深色头发、表情丰富，穿宽松图案 T 恤、宽松工装裤和干净运动鞋。全程严格保持脸、发型、服装和身份一致。

0—4 秒：火花
低机位跟拍人物手拿冰镇饮料罐，随意走过多彩的现代城市街道。周围悄悄出现可爱的手绘星星、闪电、爱心和柠檬。他停下，切到布满冷凝水的饮料罐微距特写。他拉开罐子，发出开罐声。罐子上方出现一枚小闪电，随声音振动。
4—8 秒：火花太多了
他喝下一大口，多彩涂鸦立即从身后涌出。闪电划过画面，柠檬弹跳着经过镜头，星星在头边绽开，漫画速度线包围身体。他先惊讶，再咧嘴笑。镜头快速推进。
8—15 秒：加速
他突然高速向前冲。奔跑穿过城市时，用快速甩镜、低机位跟拍、动感手持镜头和速度变化表现冲劲。每次脚步触发星形爆点，挥臂触发闪电，跳跃触发漫画爆炸，转弯触发弧形速度线，微笑触发漂浮小爱心。涂鸦要与真实环境互动，绕过杆子、从墙面弹开并跟随人物。到第 15 秒，他冲向城市阶梯准备跃上；以快速向前的镜头过渡，自然衔接第二段。
镜头与剪辑：快速广告剪辑，但动作持续流畅；使用甩镜、快速变焦、低位跟拍、速度变化和动作匹配剪辑，让整段像连续过程，而非互不相连的片段。
涂鸦：二维手绘，不完美的草图线条、俏皮表情和弹跳动画；可爱而不幼稚，与实景自然互动。

第二段：15 秒，16:9 横屏。
保持相同真人广告加二维手绘涂鸦风格、写实电影感 4K 目标、清晰产品细节、自然皮肤、鲜明灯光、流畅运动及动态镜头。严格沿用第一段同一人物的脸、发型、宽松图案 T 恤、工装裤、运动鞋和整体身份。

0—6 秒：涂鸦追逐
紧接第一段，人物跳上阶梯向上跑，数百个可爱手绘涂鸦追赶他。柠檬从楼梯弹下，闪电在旁边曲折飞行，小星星在空中旋转，鞋后短暂出现卡通火焰。快速交替低位跑步镜头、侧面跟拍、运动鞋特写、兴奋表情特写和涂鸦围绕人物旋转的俯视镜头。甩镜转场与音乐同步。
6—11 秒：产品特写
人物突然停住，一切冻结，周围涂鸦悬停。他随意将饮料罐转向镜头，过渡到产品微距特写：冷凝水、清晰标签、鲜明广告灯光和气泡活力。手绘柠檬与闪电开始围绕罐子旋转。镜头缓慢推向产品，背景保持柔和虚化。
11—15 秒：最后绽放
人物再喝一口，对着镜头露出俏皮笑容。随节拍，所有星星、闪电、柠檬、爱心和爆炸图案涌向他，再从身后向外绽成巨大的彩色手绘图案。他自信站在中央，把罐子举向镜头。以干净、高质感的产品主视觉收尾，四周是俏皮闪电、星星和水果。整体感受清爽、有活力、淘气、节奏鲜明、有趣。
镜头与剪辑：流畅的快速广告剪辑，使用甩镜、速度变化、产品微距、环绕镜头、快速变焦和动作匹配剪辑。转场由人物动作推动，并保持第一段的视觉连续性。
涂鸦：二维手绘草图线条、俏皮表情、弹跳动画；真正与实景互动，不是静态叠加。风格活泼时尚，不幼稚。

避免：人物身份、服装或脸变化，多余手指、扭曲手部、变形产品、错误罐形、不可读标志、重复罐子、人物悬空、僵硬动作、随机换场、片段不连贯、过度运动模糊、暗淡灯光、幼稚卡通环境、写实涂鸦、混乱合成、面部变形和文字瑕疵。
preparation: 准备人物与产品参考素材，使用能生成视频的工具。原提示词为两段各 15 秒；可用时长以工具实际支持为准。

低机位跟拍人物手拿冰镇饮料罐，随意走过多彩的现代城市街道。周围悄悄出现可爱的手绘星星、闪电、爱心和柠檬。他停下，切到布满冷凝水的饮料罐微距特写。他拉开罐子，发出开罐声。罐子上方出现一枚小闪电，随声音振动。
4—8 秒：火花太多了
他喝下一大口，多彩涂鸦立即从身后涌出。闪电划过画面，柠檬弹跳着经过镜头，星星在头边绽开，漫画速度线包围身体。他先惊讶，再咧嘴笑。镜头快速推进。
8—15 秒：加速
他突然高速向前冲。奔跑穿过城市时，用快速甩镜、低机位跟拍、动感手持镜头和速度变化表现冲劲。每次脚步触发星形爆点，挥臂触发闪电，跳跃触发漫画爆炸，转弯触发弧形速度线，微笑触发漂浮小爱心。涂鸦要与真实环境互动，绕过杆子、从墙面弹开并跟随人物。到第 15 秒，他冲向城市阶梯准备跃上；以快速向前的镜头过渡，自然衔接第二段。
镜头与剪辑：快速广告剪辑，但动作持续流畅；使用甩镜、快速变焦、低位跟拍、速度变化和动作匹配剪辑，让整段像连续过程，而非互不相连的片段。
涂鸦：二维手绘，不完美的草图线条、俏皮表情和弹跳动画；可爱而不幼稚，与实景自然互动。

promptParts.title: 第二段
promptParts.original: PART 2: MOUNTAIN DEW SPARK — “TOO MUCH SPARK” Duration: 15 seconds Aspect Ratio: 16:9 Style: Premium live-action commercial + playful 2D hand-drawn doodle animation, funky, energetic, youthful, colorful, fast-paced. Visual Quality: Ultra-realistic cinematic 4K, crisp product photography, natural skin texture, vibrant commercial lighting, smooth motion, dynamic camera work. CHARACTER: Continue with EXACTLY the same young male from Part 1. Same face, hairstyle, oversized graphic T-shirt, baggy cargo pants, sneakers and overall identity. STRICT IDENTITY AND OUTFIT LOCK. 0–6s — DOODLE CHAOS Continue directly from Part 1 as the boy jumps onto a city staircase and races upward. Hundreds of cute hand-drawn doodles chase after him. Animated lemons bounce down the stairs. Lightning bolts zigzag beside him. Tiny stars spin through the air. Cartoon flames briefly appear behind his sneakers. Rapidly alternate between: Low-angle running shot Side tracking shot Close-up of sneakers Close-up of his excited expression Overhead shot as doodles spiral around him Use energetic whip transitions synchronized with the music. 6–11s — PRODUCT HERO The boy suddenly stops. Everything freezes. The doodles freeze mid-air around him. He casually spins the Mountain Dew Spark can toward the camera. Transition into a premium macro product close-up: cold condensation, sharp label detail, vibrant commercial lighting and fizzy energy. Hand-drawn lemons and lightning bolts begin orbiting around the can. The camera slowly pushes toward the product while the background remains softly blurred. 11–15s — FINAL EXPLOSION He takes one final sip and smirks directly at camera. On the beat, every doodle in the scene rushes toward him: ⭐ ⚡ 🍋 ❤️ 💥 They explode outward into a giant colorful hand-drawn burst behind him. He stands confidently in the center, holding the Mountain Dew Spark can toward camera. End on a clean premium hero shot of the Mountain Dew Spark can surrounded by playful doodle lightning, stars and fruit. Final feeling: refreshing, energetic, mischievous, funky and irresistibly fun. CAMERA & EDITING: Fast commercial editing with smooth continuous motion. Use whip pans, speed ramps, macro product photography, orbiting camera movement, crash zooms and match cuts. Transitions should be motivated by the character's movement and preserve visual continuity from Part 1. DOODLE ANIMATION: Cute hand-drawn 2D doodles with intermediate sketch lines, playful expressions and bouncy animation. Doodles should physically interact with the live-action world rather than appearing as static overlays. Keep them playful and stylish, never childish. NEGATIVE PROMPT: No character identity changes, no outfit changes, no inconsistent face, no extra fingers, no distorted hands, no warped product, no incorrect can shape, no unreadable logo, no duplicate cans, no floating character, no stiff movement, no random scene changes, no disconnected clips, no excessive motion blur, no dull lighting, no childish cartoon environment, no photorealistic doodles, no messy compositing, no deformed facial features, no text artifacts.
promptParts.zh:
第二段：15 秒，16:9 横屏。
保持相同真人广告加二维手绘涂鸦风格、写实电影感 4K 目标、清晰产品细节、自然皮肤、鲜明灯光、流畅运动及动态镜头。严格沿用第一段同一人物的脸、发型、宽松图案 T 恤、工装裤、运动鞋和整体身份。

0—6 秒：涂鸦追逐
紧接第一段，人物跳上阶梯向上跑，数百个可爱手绘涂鸦追赶他。柠檬从楼梯弹下，闪电在旁边曲折飞行，小星星在空中旋转，鞋后短暂出现卡通火焰。快速交替低位跑步镜头、侧面跟拍、运动鞋特写、兴奋表情特写和涂鸦围绕人物旋转的俯视镜头。甩镜转场与音乐同步。
6—11 秒：产品特写
人物突然停住，一切冻结，周围涂鸦悬停。他随意将饮料罐转向镜头，过渡到产品微距特写：冷凝水、清晰标签、鲜明广告灯光和气泡活力。手绘柠檬与闪电开始围绕罐子旋转。镜头缓慢推向产品，背景保持柔和虚化。
11—15 秒：最后绽放
人物再喝一口，对着镜头露出俏皮笑容。随节拍，所有星星、闪电、柠檬、爱心和爆炸图案涌向他，再从身后向外绽成巨大的彩色手绘图案。他自信站在中央，把罐子举向镜头。以干净、高质感的产品主视觉收尾，四周是俏皮闪电、星星和水果。整体感受清爽、有活力、淘气、节奏鲜明、有趣。
镜头与剪辑：流畅的快速广告剪辑，使用甩镜、速度变化、产品微距、环绕镜头、快速变焦和动作匹配剪辑。转场由人物动作推动，并保持第一段的视觉连续性。
涂鸦：二维手绘草图线条、俏皮表情、弹跳动画；真正与实景互动，不是静态叠加。风格活泼时尚，不幼稚。

避免：人物身份、服装或脸变化，多余手指、扭曲手部、变形产品、错误罐形、不可读标志、重复罐子、人物悬空、僵硬动作、随机换场、片段不连贯、过度运动模糊、暗淡灯光、幼稚卡通环境、写实涂鸦、混乱合成、面部变形和文字瑕疵。
